MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS FOR APPOINTMENT OF TEACHERS AND OTHER

FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF LEGAL STUDIES
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
POST OF GUEST FACULTY IN UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF LEGAL
STUDIES, PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
Posts No. of
seats
Honorarium
Guest Faculty
(English)
01 Rs. 1500/- per lecture subject to
maximum of Rs. 50,000/- per month
Minimum Qualification: Master’s degree with55%marks (50% marks in case
of SC/ST) or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system
is followed) and UGC-NET or Ph.D. in English, as per UGC REGULATIONS ON
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS FOR APPOINTMENT OF TEACHERS AND OTHER
ACADEMIC STAFF IN UNIVERSITIES AND COLLEGES AND MEASURES FOR
THE MAINTENANCE OF STANDARDS IN HIGHER EDUCATION, 2018
All the applicants are advised to send/submit their applications to the
Director, University Institute of Legal Studies, Panjab University, Chandigarh
along with all self attested copies of their certificates and other relevant
documents including publications for verification along with the duly filled
application form and template pages 1 to 11 available at:
https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pd
f Hard copy submitted in the office of UILS, PU, Chandigarh on or before 21st
October by 4:00 pm. (Late applications will not be considered).
The candidate shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any
fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency till they are
teaching at University Institute of Legal Studies, Panjab University, Chandigarh
as a Guest Faculty. The candidates are requested to keep on checking the
Panjab University and UILS website for further updates.
sd/-
Director
